# `csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint`

Put a where clause on its own line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public T Max<T>(T a, T b) where T : IComparable<T>
    {
        return a.CompareTo(b) >= 0 ? a : b;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint = true`

```ini
csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public T Max<T>(T a, T b)
        where T : IComparable<T>
    {
        return a.CompareTo(b) >= 0 ? a : b;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint = false`

```ini
csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
